name: Araragi
source:
A mysterious girl clad in a military uniform. She is an elusive presence who sometimes shows herself before Tsukasa. Despite her small stature, she talks like an adult, bringing on the feeling that she is wise beyond her years.

Being well familiar with Tsukasa's situation, she sometimes gives him advice, but…?

[i]"So long as you cannot correct the distortion, you will never return to the future. So put that great head of yours to work, great detective."[i]
